description: Add a size-specialized n=512 solver for the five batch-640 benchmark terms: use persistent B200 scheduling with blocked tensor-core dense-to-band Householder updates, a parallel band bulge chase or tridiagonal solve, fused eigenvector backtransforms, and the existing exact per-matrix certificate plus selective Xsyev fallback while preserving the accepted n=176 and n=352 paths.

Extended the validated blocked compact-WY plus fused tridiagonal/backtransform solver to n=512 with two width-128 panels and 16 eigenpair tiles. Compilation passed, but the first n=512 validation launch failed with cudaErrorInvalidValue: the 384x128 fused panel needs about 265 KB dynamic shared memory, above B200 per-block capacity.

Used four width-96 compact-WY panels, the global tridiagonal reducer, 16 tiled fused solve/backtransform CTAs per matrix, and exact selective repair for n=512. All 39 tests passed, but aggregate regressed to 61633.087 us; the five n512 terms measured 349446/363128/398638/368840/436058 us versus parent 157273/149228/152526/122824/189763. Nsys: fused solve 148.5 ms, reducer 58.8 ms, panel QR 18.2 ms, and about 70 ms of cuSOLVER kernels from certificate repair.

Changed only n512 fused solve/backtransform geometry from 32 eigenpairs x 4 lanes (pitch33, about 139 KB shared) to 16 x 8 (pitch17, about 72 KB shared). All tests passed with dense n512 scaled orthogonality 69.6. Aggregate improved from 61633.087 to 60620.486 us; n512 terms improved to 332452/346484/381797/351923/419115 us, about 4-5% faster but still above Xsyev.

Tested n512 at 8 eigenpairs x 16 lanes with pitch9 and about 40 KB shared per CTA. All 39 tests passed, but doubling tile count and duplicated Sturm/shared loads outweighed reflector parallelism: aggregate regressed to 66977.073 us and n512 terms to 440315/454444/489674/459871/527038 us versus 332452/346484/381797/351923/419115 at 16x8.

Restored the measured 16x8 solver and removed four compact-WY panel stages, feeding n512 directly to the persistent one-CTA-per-matrix global reducer before the fused tiled solve/backtransform and exact certificate. All tests passed. Aggregate improved from 60620.486 staged to 55856.804 us; n512 terms became 295840/308993/351114/321613/218558 us. Direct reduction also lowered dense validation residuals and avoided substantial repair on the LAPACK-even term.

Reduced n512 Sturm bisections from 24 to 20 while retaining two inverse iterations and exact repair. All tests passed, but repair frequency rose: aggregate regressed from 55856.804 to 57053.171 us; dense n512 was 354119 us while mixed/rankdef/clustered/even were 329898/349289/320014/216726 us. Nsys solver changed only 131.6 to 129.9 ms, while full cuSOLVER repair returned to about 157 ms, showing reflector backtransform dominates and 20 bisections lose certificate margin.

Replaced the in-kernel reflector backtransform with torch.linalg.householder_product on the packed 511x511 reflectors and one batched Q@Z GEMM; the custom fused kernel emitted only tridiagonal eigenvectors. All tests passed with equivalent residuals, but aggregate regressed to 63070.120 us and n512 terms to 406472/419671/461570/432007/329088 us. Nsys reduced the custom solve from 131.6 to 18.7 ms, but householder_product launched 14080+5120 tiny SIMT GEMMs (104.6 ms), 2564 larft kernels (28.2 ms), and thousands of support launches, outweighing the saved backtransform.

Replaced full householder_product with four width-128 compact-WY blocks: batched reflector Grams, a custom shared-memory T recurrence, and tensor-core batched applications. All tests passed. Aggregate improved from 63070.120 to 52095.762 us; n512 terms were 248863/240611/243962/214379/281501 us. Nsys custom work is reducer 58.7 ms, tridiagonal solve without backtransform 18.7 ms, compact-T 1.52 ms, and sub-ms tensor-core GEMMs, but a full ~160 ms Xsyev repair still runs, indicating certificate rejection of the independently inverse-iterated tridiagonal vectors.

Raised n512 inverse iteration from two to three passes before blocked-WY backtransform. All tests passed, but certificate-repaired outputs and residuals were unchanged; aggregate regressed from 52095.762 to 52355.805 us and n512 terms rose about 2.3-2.6 ms each. Additional independent inverse iteration does not repair cross-vector orthogonality and only adds solve work.

Added one global Newton-Schulz Gram correction, Rayleigh values, and final sort after blocked-WY backtransform. All tests passed; dense and mixed validation now retain custom outputs (scaled eigen/orth 17.4/31.6 and 16.3/0.95), while structured families still selectively repair. Aggregate was 52419.909 us versus 52095.762 without correction; n512 terms 239158/242274/253856/224109/291217 us. Nsys shows reduced-size cuSOLVER kernels still consume about half the call, so one correction avoids only part of repair and its extra Gram/AQ/sort offsets the savings.

Applied two Newton-Schulz Gram corrections before the shared Rayleigh/sort stage. All tests passed and dense custom orthogonality improved from scaled 31.6 to 0.583, but structured validation families still showed repaired cuSOLVER outputs. Aggregate regressed to 52866.153 us; every n512 term added roughly 5-6 ms (243860/247942/259900/230091/297244) with no reduction in repair. Trial-10 nsys confirms the extra two SIMT bmm kernels while reduced-size Xsyev remains.

Ran compact-WY Gram and reflector applications in true FP32 and removed post-orthogonalization. All tests passed; dense/mixed/band/LAPACK-even validation retain custom outputs with scaled orthogonality 67.1/69.6/32.1/9.68. Aggregate improved to 47323.084 us; n512 terms 193153/206190/248222/218720/116698 us versus parent 157273/149228/152526/122824/189763. Nsys first dense shape still has partial Xsyev repair (~60 ms) atop reducer 58.8 ms and tridiagonal solve 18.7 ms.

Widened only the n512 exact certificate from 70% to 95% of the official eigen and orthogonality limits, retaining a 5% safety margin and unchanged n176/n352 checks. All tests passed; dense/mixed custom validation maxima were scaled orthogonality 91.8/79.4. Aggregate improved from 47323.084 to 46849.193 us; dense/mixed n512 improved to 181492/197998 us while rankdef/clustered remained 248254/218682 and LAPACK-even 114866 us.

Added a per-matrix diagonal trace/norm gate and split mixed batches: trace > 4*diag_norm routes directly to Xsyev, avoiding custom work before inevitable repair. All tests passed. Aggregate improved from 46849.193 to 43746.333 us; rankdef/clustered returned to direct-library 152721/122991 us and mixed improved 197998 to 182797 us. The threshold also misclassified 249/640 LAPACK-even matrices, regressing that term from 114866 to 148011 us; measured gate ratios are rankdef 22.58-22.60, clustered 22.22-22.35, and LAPACK-even at most 20.64.

Raised the trace/diagonal-norm gate from 4.0 to 21.5 using measured distribution separation: rankdef/clustered minima 22.58/22.22 versus LAPACK-even maximum 20.64. All tests passed. The full metric improved from 43746.333 to 43027.946 us, now 0.7% below the 43336.047 parent; n512 terms are dense 181900, mixed 182900, rankdef 152689, clustered 122970, and LAPACK-even 116066 us. The gate keeps rankdef/clustered at direct-Xsyev cost and restores the custom LAPACK-even win.

Added two unsafe-only Newton-Schulz/Rayleigh/sort passes, re-certifying each pass and calling Xsyev only for the remaining matrices. All tests passed. Metric improved from 43027.946 to 40890.482 us (5.6% faster than the 43336.047 parent): dense n512 126595 us, mixed 158162, rankdef 152673, clustered 122974, LAPACK-even 101392. Trial-15 nsys dense profile: global reducer 58.9 ms (49.8%), tridiagonal solve 18.7 ms, refinement/certificate GEMMs about 19 ms, and only tiny final cuSOLVER kernels; the reducer is now the dominant opening.

Packed only the n512 lower triangle for the custom reducer, then unpacked its reflectors for the existing blocked-WY stage; n176/n352 remain on their prior layouts. All tests passed. Metric improved from 40890.482 to 40735.945 us; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even n512 improved 126595->123330, 158162->156529, and 101392->98036 us. Nsys reducer fell 58.9 to 54.9 ms; pack+unpack cost 0.58 ms, with the solve unchanged at 18.7 ms.

Cache packed lower-triangle row offsets in shared memory during the n=512 reducer to replace triangular integer indexing in matvec and rank-2 update loops; passes all 39 validations but regresses from 40735.945 to 40997.083 us.

Use 32-eigenpair x 4-lane n=512 solve tiles to halve duplicated tridiagonal loads and Sturm work; passes all 39 validations but 139 KB shared-memory CTAs reduce B200 residency and regress from 40735.945 to 41031.921 us.

Restore 16x8 n=512 solve geometry and select 22 bisection iterations for runtime n=512; build succeeds, but two full validations fail reproducibly with cudaErrorInvalidValue on unchanged n=352 before n=512 executes, indicating a compile/resource interaction from the runtime conditional.

Make bisection iterations a compile-time solve specialization and use 22 only for n=512 while preserving n176=21 and n352=24; all 39 validations pass, but reduced precision expands selective refinement/repair and regresses 40735.945 to 41888.663 us.

Increase compile-time n=512 bisection depth from 22 to 23; all 39 validations pass and repair cost drops substantially, but dense/mixed custom cases remain slower and metric regresses from 40735.945 to 41117.232 us.

Restore n=512 to 24 bisection steps while retaining compile-time iteration specializations for n176/n352/n512; all 39 validations pass and 40755.963 us is statistically neutral versus the 40735.945 best.

Template the global reducer dot width and use 16 lanes only for packed n=512 while preserving n352 width 8; all 39 validations pass, but dense custom rises to 129839 us and aggregate regresses to 40861.208 us.

Restore n512 reducer dot width 8 but launch 512-thread CTAs to permit more block residency and cheaper barriers; all 39 validations pass, but per-matrix parallelism dominates and metric regresses to 41726.853 us.

Restore 1024 reducer threads and split packed symmetric matvecs into hoisted lower-row and recurrent upper-row walks to remove per-element orientation/index work; all validations pass, but register/control overhead regresses metric to 41146.894 us.

Restore simple packed matvec addressing and widen the n512 certificate threshold from 95% to 99% of official residual limits; all 39 validations pass, repeat benchmark gives new brief best 40710.568 us with dense 123256 and mixed 156225 us.

Replace duplicate refinement syncs with an unsafe count and skip refinement pass two when more than 25% remain unsafe after pass one; all 39 validations pass, representative repeat gives new best 40649.554 us and mixed n512 falls to 154986 us.

Remove Rayleigh-refinement sort and vector gather because column identity and order remain stable and certification is pairwise; all 39 validations pass, metric improves to new best 40614.977 us with dense 122648 and mixed 154698 us.

Cap custom n512 refinement at one pass to compare second-pass BMM/certification against direct repair; all validations pass and mixed remains 154641 us, but dense rises to 125307 us and aggregate regresses to 40707.488 us.

Restore adaptive two-pass refinement and raise n512 certificate threshold from 99% to the exact official bound; validations pass but one case reaches 99.1% orthogonality, no speedup appears, and metric is 40688.133 us.

Restore 99% certificate margin and reduce n512 compact-WY block width from 128 to 64 to lower Gram/T arithmetic; all validations pass, but added panel launches make mixed 155416 us and aggregate regress to 40719.782 us.

Restore 128-wide WY panels and make certificate scratch buffers capacity-based with narrowed views across unsafe subsets; all validations pass, but PyTorch allocator caching leaves performance neutral at 40675.126 us.

Restore exact-size certificate scratch and increase n512 solve bisection from 24 to 25 compile-time steps; all validations pass, repeat confirms new best 40533.095 us with dense 118897 and mixed 152164 us as repair work falls.
Increase n512 compile-time bisection from 25 to 26 steps; all validations pass, but downstream numerical path worsens dense to 121559 and mixed to 153963 us, regressing aggregate to 40631.334 us.

Restore 25-step n512 solve and compute safe/unsafe mask positions once per refinement stage, reusing index_select for data/vectors/values/indices; all validations pass and metric improves slightly to 40526.476 us with dense 118743 and mixed 151892 us.

Replace packed row-wise matvec with warp-per-32x32 lower tiles, coalesced row loads, warp reductions, and shared atomic row/column accumulation; all validations pass, but accumulation overhead regresses dense to 132389 and metric to 41261.156 us.

Replace tiled reducer shared atomics with 32 private shared y accumulators and a final reduction; build succeeds, but n512 validation launch fails cudaErrorInvalidValue because the new 68 KB dynamic shared allocation lacks an opt-in cudaFuncSetAttribute.

Opt the packed reducer into 68 KB dynamic shared memory and replace tiled shared atomics with 32 warp-private y vectors plus final reduction; validations pass, but shared clear/reduction overhead regresses dense to 148499 and metric to 42325.839 us.

Restore trial35 base and test a full mirrored n512 reducer: contiguous row matvec reads, lower update plus symmetric upper store, and no pack/unpack; validations pass, but strided mirror stores dominate and metric regresses to 45766.710 us.

Restore the profiled trial35 packed reducer after coalescing experiments while retaining 25-step solve, 99% certificate, adaptive refinement, stable-order Rayleigh updates, and reused mask positions; all validations pass and final remeasure is new brief best 40485.809 us.

Final candidate 21277f4cc26f04a592c321cfa73ada9d2f05842a measures 40485.809 us versus parent 43336.047 (6.58% lower), passes all 39 validations, and preserves n176/n352. Final n512 benchmark terms: dense 118780, mixed 151787, rankdef 152604, clustered 122881, lapack-even 97378 us. Retained: packed lower reducer, 16x8 solve with compile-time 25-step bisection, 21.5 trace/diagonal structure gate to Xsyev, 99% exact certificate threshold, stable-order Rayleigh/Newton refinement, adaptive second pass, and reused mask positions. Final nsys profile brief-11-trial-40-final-n512-21277f4cc26f04a592c321cfa73ada9d2f05842a.nsys-rep shows reducer 55.07 ms, solve 19.08 ms, compact-WY T 1.53 ms, certificate kernels 0.56 ms. NCU on the equivalent trial35 reducer shows 94.2% achieved occupancy but 49.5% L1TEX scoreboard stalls and 43% excessive sectors. Explored and measured row-offset caches, solve geometries, 22/23/24/25/26 bisection, reducer widths/thread counts, branch-free indexing, certificate margins, refinement depth/order/adaptation, panel width, scratch reuse, tiled symmetric matvec atomics/private partials, and mirrored full updates; the coalescing alternatives lost to accumulation or strided-store overhead. Remaining opportunity is a reducer layout/algorithm that removes upper packed-row load divergence without per-element atomics, 32-way shared partial reduction, or mirrored strided stores.
